project_guidance.title: Welsh domestic heat-pump checks
project_guidance.intro: Use this starting point with the full official guidance and the planning history for your address.
rules: Use the Welsh air-source heat-pump requirements updated on 1 June 2026.
The allowance is up to two units for detached homes or one for other homes, with an outdoor compressor volume no greater than 1.5 cubic metres.
Check MCS 020(a), roof and highway siting, listed-building and conservation restrictions, and the permitted heating use.
